findings.title: Persistence failure mislabels successful restoration and masks original failure
findings.scenario: Official reorg rejects, official finally restores automine/interval successfully, final evidence persist fails. Current catch changes miningControlsRestored to false, performs a second failing persist, and throws only that write failure instead of retaining the original reorg failure. Independently reproduced against exact helper.
findings.repair: Separate control readback from persistence; set restoration fact solely from readback outcome. Attempt bounded evidence persistence without overwriting that fact, then aggregate original operation, restoration and persistence failures. Preserve durable once intent; never repeat the reorg. Add original-error plus failed-final-write and successful-operation plus failed-final-write regressions.
